jobs.description:
Kok til thailandsk køkken

Brænder du for det autentiske thailandske køkken, og trives du i et travlt og velorganiseret køkken med høje kvalitetskrav? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

Hos Thai Cooking i Hellerup har vi i næsten 20 år lavet frisklavet, velsmagende thaimad til vores mange faste kunder. Vi søger nu en dygtig og selvstændig kok til at indgå i vores faste køkkenteam.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver:

• 
Tilberedning af autentiske thailandske retter fra bunden (herunder wokretter, karryretter, supper og forretter) efter vores opskrifter og standarder.

• 
Klargøring af de friske råvarer, forberedelse af saucer og forretter, samt tilsmagning.

• 
Varemodtagelse, kvalitetskontrol af råvarer samt medansvar for lagerstyring og bestilling.

• 
Opretholdelse af høj hygiejnestandard og egenkontrol i henhold til Fødevarestyrelsens regler.

• 
Samarbejde med det øvrige køkkenpersonale om en effektiv og god arbejdsdag.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

• 
Har solid praktisk erfaring som kok – gerne med speciale i eller indgående kendskab til det thailandske/asiatiske køkken.

• 
Kan bevare overblikket og det gode humør, når der er travlt i aften- og weekendtimerne.

• 
Arbejder struktureret, hygiejnisk og sætter en ære i, at hver eneste ret forlader køkkenet i høj kvalitet.

• 
Er mødestabil, ansvarsbevidst og en god holdspiller.

• 
Taler og forstår enten dansk, engelsk eller thai.

Vi tilbyder:

• 
En fast fuldtidsstilling (40 timer om ugen) i en veletableret og sund virksomhed.

• 
En uformel og venlig arbejdsplads med erfarne kollegaer, hvor vi hjælper hinanden.

• 
Løn efter kvalifikationer og gældende vilkår.

• 
Arbejdstider primært i eftermiddags- og aftentimerne samt weekender efter fast vagtplan.

--

Chef to Thai Cuisine

Are you passionate about authentic Thai cuisine, and do you thrive in a busy, well-organized kitchen with high quality standards? If so, you might be the person we are looking for!

At Thai Cooking in Hellerup , we have been preparing fresh, delicious Thai food for our many regular customers for almost 20 years. We are now seeking a skilled and independent chef to join our permanent kitchen team.

Your primary responsibilities:

• 
Preparing authentic Thai dishes from scratch (including stir-fries, curries, soups, and appetizers) according to our recipes and standards.

• 
Preparing fresh ingredients, making sauces and appetizers, and seasoning dishes.

• 
Receiving goods, performing quality control on ingredients, and sharing responsibility for inventory management and ordering.

• 
Maintaining high hygiene standards and internal quality control in accordance with the Danish Veterinary and Food Administration’s regulations.

• 
Collaborating with the rest of the kitchen staff to ensure an efficient and positive workday.

We expect that you:

• 
Have solid practical experience as a chef—ideally with a specialization in, or in-depth knowledge of, Thai/Asian cuisine.

• 
Can maintain a clear overview and a positive attitude during busy periods, such as evenings and weekends.

• 
Work in a structured and hygienic manner, and take pride in ensuring that every single dish leaves the kitchen at a high standard of quality.

• 
Are reliable, responsible, and a good team player.

• 
Speak and understand either Danish, English, or Thai. 

We offer:

• 
A permanent, full-time position (40 hours per week) in a well-established and financially sound company.

• 
An informal and friendly workplace with experienced colleagues who support one another.

• 
Salary based on qualifications and applicable terms.

• 
Working hours primarily during the afternoon and evening, as well as weekends, according to a fixed schedule.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Position: Challenge-based Research in the Humanities
jobs.description:
The Nordic Humanities Center for Challenge-Based Inquiry invites applications for a 2-year postdoc to be filled by February 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

In recent years, a set of overlapping but different concepts have been used to describe a more world-oriented direction of the research conducted at universities: applied science, mission-driven research, challenge-based inquiry etc. These concepts and methods take on specific forms when they are adopted in the humanities. From a sociology of science or history of science perspective, the postdoc is expected 1) to map recent years' transformation within the academy towards challenge-based approaches and specific initiatives in Denmark and the Nordic countries – with a focus on the humanities, 2) to map how Danish and Nordic scholars in the humanities themselves engage in and conceptualize research on societal challenges, how they cooperate with external partners, and what humanists themselves consider to be the possibilities and challenges of this type of research, 3) to conduct an individual research project within this area, and 4) to contribute to the activities and events in the center.

The Nordic Humanities Center for Challenge-Based Inquiry is an innovative and ambitious center of advanced study that fosters new ways of doing humanities research. The center has been established in a collaboration between the faculties of the Humanities at the University of Copenhagen and the University of Southern Denmark with the generous support of the A.P. Møller Foundation. Over the course of the next six years, the center will each year gather a group of scholars at the two universities to marshal insights from the humanities and develop new perspectives, nuances, frames, and narratives for one of the many local and global societal challenges such as, for example, inequality, war, health, artificial intelligence, or the climate crisis.

Your primary focus will be documentation for global Biologics License Applications (BLAs), Marketing Authorisation Applications (MAAs), New Drug Applications (NDAs), and responses to health authority questions during assessment. Working closely with scientific and technical experts, you will transform complex CMC information into clear, accurate, and consistent regulatory submission documents.

• Demonstrated expertise in authoring and reviewing complex CMC regulatory sections and/or supporting source documents, with the ability to independently manage writing activities and guide other authors

• A good understanding of CMC regulatory expectations across development stages and strong knowledge of CTD structure, GxP, and relevant documentation requirements

• Excellent written English, sound scientific judgment, and the ability to present complex information clearly, assess supporting data, and identify gaps and inconsistencies

• Practical experience using AI to improve scientific or technical writing quality and efficiency, including effective prompting, critical assessment of outputs, and verification of scientific content

• Strong communication and influencing skills, enabling you to align cross-functional stakeholders, resolve differing perspectives, and mentor colleagues

• A proven record of ownership, effective prioritization, and timely delivery, combined with curiosity, continuous learning, and a collaborative approach that builds trust, welcomes feedback, and supports an inclusive work environment

DKK624.000,00---936.000,00

For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. **Welcome to Semco Maritime

**At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. Care to join the movement?

Change. With us.

Then you might be our new Portfolio Specialist within parallel import.

Our business is growing fast, with more products, more markets and more competition on both the sales and purchasing side. That is why we have established Portfolio Management: a cross-functional department that steers demand and supply for our active portfolio across our European markets.

As Portfolio Specialist, you will work side by side with our Portfolio Managers and continuously find new ways to improve the profitability and accessibility of our active portfolio through new and cheaper sourcing, higher product availability and adding existing products to new sales markets. You will collaborate closely with Business Development, Sales, Purchasing, and regulatory, and your work will combine structured portfolio reviews with ad hoc tasks when changes in demand or supply call for fast and focused action.

Your primary tasks

• Continuously review the active portfolio to identify opportunities for optimization and development within the regulatory framework of each market.

• Find new, cheaper and alternative sourcing options that strengthen both profitability and product availability.

• Identify new sales opportunities for existing products together with Sales.

• Prepare analyses and business cases that support the Portfolio Managers’ decisions.

Who are you?

Curious, persistent and never satisfied with the first answer. You love working with data, lots of it, you find energy in adding profitability, and you keep digging until you find the needle in the haystack. You understand that every opportunity must hold up within the regulatory requirements of each market, and you naturally keep building your regulatory knowledge and market dynamic know-how, so your analysis stays focused on what is possible. You are structured enough to drive continuous portfolio reviews and flexible enough to switch gears when an urgent request lands on your desk. You build strong relationships across the business, share your insights generously and challenge assumptions across the value chain constructively.

You may have a degree in Business, Engineering, Economics, Supply Chain or similar, and preferably some experience with data analysis, business cases or pricing, ideally from pharma within parallel import or generics. You are strong in Excel, navigate complex IT systems with ease and get energy from automating whatever can be automated. Experience with BI tools is a big plus, and you communicate fluently in English and Danish.

What we offer

Reporting to the Head of Portfolio Management, you will join a brand-new department with strong ambitions, high visibility and a direct impact on 2care4’s profitability. We are moving towards an increasingly automated environment, where we challenge the "as is" and set the bar high for replacing manual tasks with smart systems and automated calculations, so more time goes to the analyses that matter. You will help shape that journey in a cooperative, informal culture where we share knowledge, use yesterday’s lessons to build a stronger tomorrow, and enjoy a good laugh along the way. You will get thorough onboarding, a manager who invests in your development and colleagues who are always ready to help, because when you grow, so does the portfolio.

Our head office in Esbjerg is your home base. You will work from Esbjerg at least two days a week, and during onboarding you will spend most of your time here, so you get the best possible start with the team and the business. Beyond that, you can use our growing office in Odense and work from home when it makes sense for you and the team. We believe the best results are created together, so most of your week will be spent at one of our offices. We value close communication and direct collaboration with our stakeholders and 5-15 days of traveling per year is expected.

Do you want to grow together?

Apply via the application link with your application and CV. We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. For further information, contact Daniel Justesen, Head of Portfolio Management, at dju@2care4.dk

About 2care4

2care4 is an international pharmaceutical company headquartered in Esbjerg, Denmark. Our mission is to make medicines more accessible to patients across Europe, and every day we strive to create value through quality, innovation and strong partnerships.

**About The Role

**We're seeking a driven Business Intelligence Analyst to join our FP&A team, reporting to our FP&A Data Lead - someone early in their data career who's eager to help build our new data platform and grow with it, in a high-impact role that offers real visibility and room to grow.

Now a delisted, growth-equity backed business, OrderYOYO is entering an exciting new chapter – a clear testament to our bold growth ambitions and the fast paced, high-impact environment we are building.

We're building a new data platform that brings together data from every restaurant partner, both on our own platform and on the platforms we acquire. Our Data team builds the pipelines, warehouse and core models; this role sits between them and the people who use the data, turning what lands in the warehouse into something the business can actually work with.

In this role, you'll gain broad exposure across the business by collaborating with Management, Finance, Commercial teams, Tech and Product Owners. You'll play a key role in turning data into actionable insights, including translating business questions into something measurable, modelling the right data, building the reporting and presenting findings for key stakeholders. As you grow, you'll have the freedom to shape your path based on your strengths and interests.

**Here's a Taste Of What You'll Be Doing

**

• Get to know our data warehouse in depth - what data we have, where it comes from and what it can be trusted for - and help scope and integrate data from the companies we acquire.

• Model data into analysis-ready datasets, so the rest of the FP&A team can find and use the right data without starting from raw data every time.

• Write SQL to pull and shape data for Management, Finance, Commercial and Data Science.

• Build and maintain reporting in Power BI - dashboards, recurring management reports and KPI scorecards - and keep the metric definitions behind them consistent, so the business has one version of each number.

• Check data quality, reconcile figures that don't match across sources, and explain why a number moved.

• Turn stakeholder questions into measurable analysis, such as why a new market is ramping up slower than expected or which partners are at risk of churning, and turn recurring requests into reusable models or reports.

**What We Are Looking For In You

**

• A degree in a quantitative or data-related field, such as economics, statistics, engineering, computer science or information systems.

• Solid SQL skills you have used in practice - in a job, a project or your studies.

• Some understanding of data modelling (how tables, keys and dimensions fit together), or a clear wish to learn it.

• Experience with, or a strong interest in, a BI tool such as Power BI, Tableau or Looker.

• Strong business sense. Curious about which numbers matter and why the business wants them.

• Structured and careful. You check your own numbers before someone else has to.

• A team player who enjoys helping colleagues get to the data they need, with strong communication in English (Danish is a plus but not a requirement).

**Why Join Us?

**

• Help build a modern data platform early in your career, while it is still taking shape, with data that Management uses to make decisions from day one.

• A clear growth path - from learning the platform and supporting the team, to owning metric definitions and how we report.

• Work in a supportive, team-first culture where we help each other succeed.

• Expect personal development plans and ongoing training tailored to your growth.

• Be part of a high-growth journey in a growth equity-backed company, where ambition meets opportunity - and your impact truly matters.

**Great To Have (But Not Required)

**

• Understanding of database structures and data modelling, such as star schemas and semantic models.

• Understanding of how SQL is used to query, model and transform data.

• Hands-on experience with Power BI, including DAX and Power Query.

• Familiarity with finance or commercial concepts, such as cohort modelling.

**What We Do At OrderYOYO

**OrderYOYO is a provider of white-label online ordering, payment, marketing, and POS software solutions to independent local takeaway restaurants. We are ensuring that small to medium-sized restaurants and chains are not subjected to lofty commissions and giving the restaurant the ownership of their success.

**Who We Are At OrderYOYO

**Company culture is at the forefront of our minds creating an enjoyable, safe working environment where employee personal expression is supported. We are one team here at OrderYOYO and strive to help others succeed. Personal development and training plans are a key part of your journey within OrderYOYO, helping you be the best you can be by providing consistent and ongoing training for all aspects of the business. Our values (Passion, Action, Compassion, One team) are what makes us who we are and will be embedded in your day-to-day no matter what area of the business you work in.

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. **The Role

**_**Please note this is a temporary cover (parental leave)

Genmab is looking for a Senior Manager to join Digital Development and cover a period of parental leave. You will lead the planning, coordination and delivery of digital initiatives, with a primary focus on establishing a streamlined workflow for application delivery. The workflow will connect business needs, development, governance, testing, deployment and operational handover, with clear responsibilities and practical guidance at each stage.

You will also define the artifacts needed across the delivery lifecycle, consolidate templates and examples, and coordinate lightweight AI drafting assistants that support consistent documentation. You will work across business and technology teams, so strong project management skills, an understanding of the application lifecycle and knowledge of Microsoft Power Apps and the wider Power Platform are essential.

**Responsibilities

**

• Own the delivery plan for the application delivery workflow: scope, deliverables, milestones, acceptance criteria, resources and dependencies.

• Map current processes and bottlenecks, agree on the future workflow and coordinate its implementation, including entry criteria, review steps, decisions and handovers.

• Establish proportionate project governance, clarify roles and decision rights, and report transparently on progress, risks, issues, actions, budget and resources.

• Coordinate business stakeholders, developers, infrastructure, architecture, information security, data privacy and Quality Assurance to secure timely input and decisions.

• Translate business needs into prioritized requirements and delivery backlogs; facilitate workshops, planning sessions and delivery meetings using agile or hybrid approaches.

• Manage risks, issues, dependencies and scope changes; resolve blockers, present options and trade-offs, and escalate where needed.

• Coordinate application delivery, including Power Apps solutions where appropriate, from requirements and environment readiness through development, integration, testing and release.

• Coordinate user acceptance testing, defect resolution and go-live readiness, ensuring that acceptance criteria and documentation and assurance requirements are met.

• Develop reusable delivery guidance, templates and checklists, and pilot the workflow on selected applications before wider rollout.

• Plan communication, training, adoption and operational handover, and track delivery performance, lead times and adoption to drive improvements.

**Delivery artifacts and AI-assisted drafting

**

• Build artifact definition cards covering purpose, phase, inputs, quality criteria, templates, review responsibilities and examples, tailored to solution type and risk.

**Requirements

**

• Experience gathering requirements, mapping processes, facilitating workshops and developing reusable delivery guidance or documentation standards.

• Knowledge of Microsoft Power Apps and Power Automate sufficient to scope and coordinate delivery; practical implementation experience is an advantage.

• Understanding of development, testing, release management and operational handover, with experience of agile or hybrid approaches and tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira and Confluence.

• Experience in regulated environments and familiarity with AI-assisted drafting are advantages.

• A relevant degree or equivalent professional experience, and strong written and spoken English. Project management certification is an advantage.

You are structured, proactive and accountable, with strong planning and follow-through. You maintain an overview, facilitate decisions and communicate clearly with technical teams and senior stakeholders. You are pragmatic, manage competing priorities and turn scattered knowledge into clear guidance.

**You will follow applicable company policies, SOPs, security and privacy requirements and the Code of Business Ethics; coordinate specialist input on assurance and validation (including GxP where applicable); and ensure AI-generated drafts receive human review. You will share knowledge across Digital Development and partner functions and provide a structured handover at the end of the assignment.

DKK652.800,00---979.200,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

**Product Management at Dalux – Bringing AI into the Construction Industry

**Dalux continues to grow rapidly, and AI is creating entirely new possibilities for how construction professionals find information, understand complex project data, automate repetitive work, and make decisions.

We're looking for an AI Product Manager to help turn those possibilities into products that create real value for our users.

As an AI Product Manager at Dalux, you'll operate at the intersection of customer needs, rapidly evolving AI technology, and business strategy. You'll work closely with Product Design, AI engineers, developers, and other Product Managers to identify where AI can meaningfully improve construction workflows – and equally importantly, where it cannot.

Building AI products is different from traditional software development. Outputs are probabilistic, quality needs continuous evaluation, and product decisions involve trade-offs between accuracy, latency, cost, scalability, and user trust.

You'll help us navigate those trade-offs and establish how we build great AI products at Dalux.

**Your responsibilities will include:

**

• AI Product Discovery: Identify and validate problems where AI can create meaningful value rather than applying AI for its own sake.

• Customer Insights: Work closely with users and internal domain experts to understand construction workflows and identify opportunities for AI-powered improvements.

• Evaluation & Quality: Define what "good" looks like for AI features and establish evals, quality metrics, test cases, and feedback loops.

• AI Safety & Trust: Consider hallucinations, uncertainty, guardrails, failure modes, explainability, and user trust throughout product development.

• Feature Ownership: Lead AI-powered features from early experimentation and prototyping through delivery, evaluation, and continuous improvement.

• Technical Collaboration: Work closely with AI engineers and developers on model capabilities, context, architecture, latency, scalability, and cost.

• AI Product Strategy: Follow developments in models and AI technology and help determine which technological advances create meaningful opportunities for Dalux.

**About You

**We are looking for someone who combines strong product thinking with a solid understanding of modern AI.

You don't need to be an AI engineer, but you need enough technical understanding to make informed product decisions and have meaningful discussions with the engineers building these systems.

We believe you:

• Have experience building or managing customer-facing AI/ML products.

• Understand concepts such as LLMs, RAG, embeddings, context, agents, evals, and guardrails.

• Understand the fundamental difference between building deterministic software and probabilistic AI experiences.

• Can translate rapidly evolving technical capabilities into valuable user experiences.

• Are comfortable defining and measuring quality where traditional acceptance criteria are insufficient.

• Think critically about when AI is – and isn't – the right solution.

• Can balance user value, model quality, latency, scalability, and cost.

• Communicate fluently in English, written and spoken.

Experience with B2B SaaS is an advantage.

Experience with construction technology is welcome but not required. We have deep construction expertise within Dalux – for this role, we are particularly interested in adding strong AI product expertise to our organization.

**What To Expect At Dalux

**At Dalux, you'll join a product-driven company where ideas quickly become reality and where you'll have a direct impact on the products we build.

We offer:

• A collaborative and informal work environment with flat hierarchies

• High ownership, trust, and the freedom to drive initiatives

• Talented and dedicated colleagues in an international team

• A central Copenhagen office, flexible work hours, and no dress code

• Monthly social events and an active community

• Attractive benefits including health insurance, lunch, fitness facilities, and free parking

• Opportunities for professional growth and development

**Ready for the next step?

**We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so please submit your resume and application as soon as possible.

**About Dalux

**Founded in 2005, Dalux is a Danish Contech company revolutionizing the construction industry with innovative software built on geometric processing and 3D computer graphics.

Over the past years, we’ve grown by 40% annually and now have over 900 employees across 50+ offices in more than 25 countries. All product development takes place in our Østerbro, Copenhagen office, where we focus on building the future of construction technology. We place great value on our strong social community and close collaboration with colleagues, which is why we primarily work from our Copenhagen location.

**Application deadline:

**As soon as possible

_**About The Role

**OrderYOYO builds the ordering apps and websites that thousands of restaurants across seven European markets use to take orders directly from their own customers. Our Growth team has one number to move: average orders per day per restaurant partner.

We're looking for a Growth Data Analyst to find where those orders are being lost, design the experiments that win them back, and prove it with data — across the end-user apps (iOS and Android), the restaurant partner websites, and the marketing stack.

This is a hands-on role. You'll write the SQL, build the test, read the result, and present it to the people who decide what ships next — working alongside a developer, a marketing manager, a paid media manager, and a data engineer.

**Role Mission

**Grow average orders per day per restaurant partner by finding where orders are lost across apps, websites and marketing channels, running the experiments that win them back, and making the Growth numbers trustworthy enough to decide on.

**Core Responsibilities

**

• Own the end-user funnel view — from visit to order to repeat order — across apps and RP websites, by country and by restaurant partner.

• Run cohort, funnel, and retention analyses to find the biggest leaks in traffic, conversion, and repeat ordering, and size what fixing each one is worth in orders per day.

• Turn findings into a ranked backlog of hypotheses with expected impact and effort, and defend the ranking with the Growth team and Product.

• Design A/B tests end to end — hypothesis, success metric, guardrails, sample size and runtime, randomisation unit, and a pre-registered analysis plan — and set them up yourself on the apps and RP websites, working with the developer on feature flags or variant logic where code changes are needed.

• Check tests while they run (sample ratio, instrumentation, novelty effects) and read them out honestly, including when the result is flat or negative.

• Bring the same discipline to the marketing stack — paid media (Google Ads, Meta), email and push, SMS, landing pages, and restaurant partners' Google Business Profiles — using geo or restaurant-level splits and holdouts where a user-level test isn't possible, and judging traffic quality and incrementality on orders, not clicks.

• Own the definitions of the Growth metrics (AOD, conversion rate, new vs returning, retention), keep them consistent between GA4, the apps, and the warehouse, and chase tracking gaps with the data engineer and developer until fixes are verified with data.

• Partner with Algirdas on the Growth dashboards in Fabric and Power BI so reporting is automated rather than produced by hand.

• Build and own the experimentation playbook, and use AI as a daily tool — for SQL, analysis plans, and readouts — helping the team build small, repeatable AI workflows such as pre-test power calculations or weekly funnel checks. Experimentation is too important to be guesswork.

**Must-Have Requirements

**

• 3 to 5 years in product, growth, or marketing analytics, ideally in a consumer app, marketplace, e-commerce, or food ordering business.

• Strong SQL — able to write and debug multi-step queries over event and transaction data without help.

• A track record of designing, running, and reading A/B tests, with the statistics to do it properly: power and sample size, significance, guardrail metrics, and the common ways a test lies (peeking, sample ratio mismatch, novelty).

• Technical enough to set up a test yourself: comfortable with feature flags or an experimentation tool, basic JavaScript or app event instrumentation, and reading a tracking plan.

• Hands-on with a product or web analytics stack (GA4 or similar) and a BI tool (Power BI, Looker, Tableau, or similar).

• Comfortable testing in marketing channels as well as in product: campaign experiments in Google Ads or Meta, email or push tests, and geo or holdout designs for measuring incrementality.

• Uses AI tools daily for analysis work and can show how it changed the way you work.

• Clear, confident communication — able to take a messy result and explain to a non-technical audience what it means and what to do next, in writing and in person.

• Owns outcomes, not tasks, and is comfortable setting the plan in a small team rather than waiting for one.

• Fluent English. Danish is not required.

**Strong-to-Have Experience

**

• Python or R for statistical analysis and automating recurring checks.

• Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, or another lakehouse and BI setup.

• Mobile app experimentation (Firebase, Optimizely, GrowthBook, Statsig, or similar) and web experimentation on multi-tenant or white-label sites.

• Sequential or Bayesian test methods, or quasi-experiments where a true A/B test isn't possible (for example, market-level or restaurant-level rollouts).

• Paid media data (Google Ads, Meta) and attribution, to judge traffic quality as well as conversion.

• A customer data platform and B2C engagement tooling (Segment, Braze, Firebase messaging, or similar), including running lifecycle tests in them.

• Building AI-assisted workflows or agents for analysis, not only using chat tools.

**Who We Are

**At OrderYOYO, company culture comes first. We create a positive, inclusive environment where people are trusted to do their best work and take ownership of what they build. Personal development is central to how we work — engineers are encouraged to grow technically, take responsibility, and help shape how our products and platforms evolve.

We help restaurants succeed online by providing branded websites, mobile apps, and tailored marketing solutions, giving them full control of their business. By removing high commission fees charged by third-party platforms, we empower restaurants to grow sustainably.

Through our partnership with AppSmart, the market leader in POS and in-store systems, we've become the largest restaurant-focused platform in Europe.

**What We Offer

**

• A salary of DKK59,000/ month

• A hybrid role based in Copenhagen.

• High ownership and autonomy over the analysis and experiments you run.

• The opportunity to directly move a revenue-critical metric: orders per day.

• A strong focus on data quality, honest experimentation, and analytics best practices.

• A collaborative, international Growth team.

• Real emphasis on learning, mentoring, and personal development.

**Bring your engineering expertise to processes that help protect lives every day

**Do you enjoy solving complex manufacturing challenges and turning technical insight into lasting improvements?

At Bavarian Nordic, we are looking for a Engineering Specialist to strengthen our Drug Substance manufacturing processes and support the introduction of new equipment and technologies.

You will join Material & Sterile Operation, reporting to the Senior Manager, and combine hands-on problem-solving with technical leadership. Your work will help ensure that our processes deliver reliable performance, consistent quality, and GMP compliance.

**Your impact

**As a technical expert for your assigned process areas, you will help develop, optimize, validate, and maintain manufacturing processes throughout their lifecycle. You will challenge existing solutions, identify risks before they affect production, and turn improvement opportunities into practical results.

Working across Manufacturing, Engineering, Automation, and Quality, you will also share your expertise and strengthen process understanding across teams.

**What You Will Do

**

• Improve process performance: Lead process design and optimization, address bottlenecks and operational risks, and troubleshoot complex manufacturing challenges to improve efficiency, reliability, and quality.

• Provide expertise in CIP/SIP: Act as a Subject Matter Expert for Cleaning-in-Place and Sterilization-in-Place systems, improving system design, component selection, and cleaning and sterilization strategies.

• Introduce equipment and technologies: Guide technical activities from specifications and vendor design reviews through factory and site acceptance testing, commissioning, qualification, and validation.

• Support validation and technology transfer: Develop validation strategies, lead and support Process Performance Qualification (PPQ), and drive the transfer of processes into manufacturing or between sites.

• Strengthen compliance: Lead and support deviations, root cause investigations, CAPAs, change controls, and risk assessments. Represent your technical areas during audits and inspections.

• Develop technical capability: Coach colleagues, provide training, and share engineering knowledge to strengthen process understanding and consistent execution.

**What You Bring

**You hold a master’s degree in Chemical, Bioprocess, Process, or Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline, and have at least 10 years of industrial process engineering experience.

You bring:

• A strong track record in process design, optimization, and structured troubleshooting within GMP manufacturing. Experience in pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, vaccines, or another highly regulated industry is strongly preferred.

• Extensive hands-on expertise in CIP/SIP design, operation, and optimization.

• In-depth knowledge of process equipment, piping, valves, and instrumentation, together with an understanding of how process and automation systems interact.

• Experience with equipment introduction, qualification, validation, PPQ, and technology transfer, including changes requiring regulatory approval.

• Solid knowledge of pharmaceutical quality systems and regulatory expectations, with practical experience in investigations, CAPAs, change controls, risk assessments, and inspection support.

**How You Work

**You combine analytical thinking with practical judgement and take ownership of moving issues towards resolution.

You are comfortable questioning established practices and can explain why a proposed change will improve process performance or reduce risk.

You communicate complex technical topics clearly, build constructive relationships across functions, and balance attention to detail with an understanding of production needs and business priorities. You also enjoy helping others develop through coaching, knowledge sharing, and collaboration.

**An opportunity to grow your leadership

**This role offers the opportunity to make an immediate impact through technical leadership. For the right candidate, it may also provide a pathway into formal people management, potentially leading a team of approximately 8–10 Process Engineers.

Progression will depend on demonstrated performance, sound judgement, and the ability to develop others, build an inclusive team environment, and translate business priorities into practical execution.

**Why join Bavarian Nordic?

**At Bavarian Nordic, we work to protect lives through vaccines. Your engineering expertise will contribute directly to the manufacturing processes that make this possible.

You will have opportunities to influence technical solutions, support important technology transfers, and see your improvements become part of daily operations. Guided by our values—Persisting Pioneers, Embracing Change, and Boosted by the Team—we work together to solve challenges and strengthen our capabilities

Lead ICT management from requirements to implementation

As our new ICT expert, you will lead ICT management, digital governance and digital delivery on multidisciplinary civil infrastructure projects. Our work includes bridges, tunnels, marine structures and other major infrastructure, often involving complex interfaces between disciplines, organisations and project phases.

You will advise clients and project organization, translate contractual and project-specific requirements into practical processes and workflows, and drive their technical implementation in collaboration with project management, engineering disciplines and digital specialists.

The position is a project-based leadership role and combines professional leadership of the ICT process, leadership of the project’s digital delivery and client-facing advice.

Your key responsibilities will include

• Lead ICT management and digital delivery through relevant project phases, from mobilisation and planning to execution and handover.

• Advise clients and project management on ICT requirements, BIM processes, information management and digital governance.

• Prepare, maintain and implement project-specific ICT documentation based on Molio’s ICT paradigms, contractual requirements and relevant industry standards.

• Translate requirements into clear roles, responsibilities, workflows, digital deliverables and quality-assurance procedures.

• Establish the project’s digital delivery framework, including model and information requirements, naming conventions, exchange procedures, coordination processes and Common Data Environment structures.

• Drive the technical implementation of ICT requirements together with project management, engineering disciplines, BIM coordinators, Digital Design specialists and other technical contributors.

• Facilitate ICT kick-off meetings, workshops and coordination activities, ensuring that agreed processes are understood and applied across the project organisation.

• Manage interfaces with internal and external stakeholders, including clients, project managers, discipline leads, architects, contractors, and international delivery teams.

• Identify opportunities for project-specific automation and digital improvements and coordinate their implementation with the relevant specialists.

• Contribute lessons learned and proven workflows to the continued development of COWI’s ICT management practices.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

The first step to success in this role is that you enjoy creating structure and direction together with others. You communicate clearly, build trusted relationships and can align stakeholders with different technical backgrounds, priorities and contractual responsibilities.

You are motivated by turning requirements and strategies into solutions that work in practice. You understand that successful ICT management requires robust governance as well as active involvement in project implementation.

On top of that, you will have:

• At least 7 years of relevant experience within ICT management, BIM management, digital project delivery or a comparable field in the engineering and construction industry.

• Practical experience leading ICT management or digital delivery on multidisciplinary projects.

• Strong knowledge of Molio’s ICT paradigms and practical experience applying them on multidisciplinary projects.

• Knowledge of relevant Danish industry standards and contractual frameworks, including YBL18 and YBB19 where applicable

• Knowledge of relevant global Industry standards such as ISO 19650

• Experience translating client and contractual requirements into practical digital processes, workflows and deliverables.

• Experience driving technical implementation, for example through Common Data Environment structures, coordination workflows, quality-control procedures, data exchanges or automated checking processes.

• A strong understanding of BIM processes, information management, digital collaboration and multidisciplinary coordination.

• General knowledge of relevant digital delivery applications such as Revit, Tekla, OpenRoadsDesign

• Experience with Coordination and Common Data Environment platforms, such as Autodesk Forma (formerly Autodesk Construction Cloud), Navisworks; Bentley Infrastructure Cloud and ProjectWise; and Trimble Connect and Quadri—or comparable systems.

• Strong planning, facilitation, communication and stakeholder-management skills.

You do not need to be a software developer or perform every technical task yourself.
